purpose: Teach: プロテスタント/永住/聖人/女系/震度/上半身/巨匠/社団

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、プロテスタント系団体への嫌がらせを、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling the harassment against the Protestant group, then?
lines.style: Measured inquiry. Slight upward lilt at the end seeking confirmation. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Respectful distance but genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、永住権詐欺事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: Yes, the police are also responding to the permanent residency fraud case.
lines.style: Clear, official confirmation. Steady voice. Nods slightly. Professional but not cold. Meeting the inquiry with straightforward reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、聖人を装った詐欺事件を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So in this case, the police are investigating the fraud where someone posed as a saint?
lines.style: Thoughtful clarification. Softer attack. Checking the facts methodically. Respectful curiosity without skepticism.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、家系図の女系改ざんも扱われますね
lines.en: Right. The police are also handling the falsified genealogical records—specifically the maternal line alterations.
lines.style: Confirming with specificity. Measured delivery. Each detail given equal weight. Professional acknowledgment of the complexity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地震の震度別被害を、警察、把握されますね
lines.en: And the police are tracking the damage distribution across earthquake magnitude levels in this case?
lines.style: Careful question. Slower pace. Respectful intonation. Checking understanding without presumption. Genuinely seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の上半身打撲を鑑識されますね
lines.en: Yes, forensics is examining the victim's upper body contusions as well.
lines.style: Direct, clinical information. Even tone. No hesitation. Professional detachment balanced with human concern.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、映画巨匠ゆかりの作品盗難を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling the theft of works associated with the renowned film director?
lines.style: Careful inquiry. Slightly formal register. Respectful of the significance. Seeking confirmation with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、公益社団法人の不正にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police are responding to misconduct at the public-interest corporation as well.
lines.style: Clear statement. Calm delivery. Slightly more measured than before. Official confirmation without elaboration. Professional closure.
